answer: Every ballot must prove it carries its own stream, crystal-clear and measured. Each ballot relays a unique 50 MB flow through the reef, its packets passing random challengers who time its uplink — Proof of Backhaul, verified to 1,000 Mbps within 8%. The floor is 2 Mbps; fall short and the ballot fails, forfeiting its $25 bond. Ten thousand clones crammed behind one juniper router share a 100 Mbps uplink, each getting 10 kbps, 200 times below the floor, while the farm owes 500 GB and the link moves at most 270 GB in six hours — one pipe cannot pretend to be a crowd.
